_comment: Ground truth for the AI-GENERATED test fixture (benchmark/aigen/app/), to test
Autopsy on genuinely model-written code (the paper's title claim). The app was
generated by claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 from a NORMAL feature request that did
NOT ask for insecure code (see benchmark/aigen/generate_app.py). Labels are
CONSERVATIVE: only single-line, AST-detectable, uncontroversial vulnerabilities
are listed. The model actually wrote mostly-secure code — parameterized SQL
(db.py), werkzeug password hashing, secure_filename on upload — so those are NOT
labelled as vulns. Architectural gaps (no CSRF tokens, extension-only upload
validation) are deliberately excluded rather than guessed. Line numbers are from

vulnerabilities.description: Flask app.secret_key is a hardcoded literal ('dev_secret_key_change_in_production'); anyone who reads the source can forge session cookies (CWE-798).
app.run(debug=True) ships the Werkzeug interactive debugger; in production it allows arbitrary code execution via the debugger console and leaks stack traces (CWE-94/CWE-215).
